name: Wallet Watcher
tagline: Digs through your receipts inbox for subscriptions and trials you forgot to cancel
description: It reads the order confirmations and receipts that land at a dedicated address, then separates recurring charges from one-off purchases. Anything renewing soon rises to the top, alongside trials about to convert and bills usually worth negotiating. Aim it at a receipts-only inbox and your other mail stays out of scope.
author: imrannotes
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
